text:
Mira Patel: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to add compatibility notes and a short limits table for Tilde-8B. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/854
Jonah Reed: skimmed — looks good overall. Can we call out the 8k vs 32k sequence behavior explicitly? folks keep tripping on it.
Alex Wu: +1. The longcontext behavior is a gotcha. Suggest a tiny snippet under 'Known limits' that shows the truncation behavior and a recommended chunking pattern.
Mira Patel: done, added a short snippet. Putting it in the PR description for now. Samira, can you run the doc linkcheck once the branch is up-to-date?
Samira (docs-bot): @Mira Patel request received. Running linkcheck and spellcheck on branch mira/tilde-compat now. Will report back in thread. :robot_face:
Jonah Reed: Also, the benchmark numbers in the card are from the old runtime (prior to kernel selection). We should either re-run or mark them as measured on runtime v1.14.0.
Mira Patel: good call. I added a parenthetical: "benchmarks measured on runtime v1.13 — see note for planned rebenchmarking". Ideally we re-run before GA but can follow up in a separate PR.
Alex Wu: The SDK snippet (python) for streaming examples uses the old param name `max_seq`. Needs to be `max_length` in SDK v3. Please update before merging.
Mira Patel: ACK. I'll push a commit to the branch to change the snippet.
Jonah Reed: left two nit comments on wording and one about punctuation. nothing blocking.
Kai: Quick question about variants — if we list an 'aurora-quant' variant here, do we need to add an explicit fallback policy entry in the catalog?
Alex Wu: Yes, add a compat note: "aurora-quant falls back to aurora-fp16 when kernels unavailable". Also add the quantization caveat: performance may vary on >16k sequences.
Mira Patel: adding both notes. Also adding a short recommendation: "Use aurora-fp16 for inference > 16k".
Samira (docs-bot): linkcheck finished: 1 broken link (bench results anchor). Suggestion: reference the canonical bench doc at /internals/benchmarks#tilde-8b instead of a relative anchor.
Mira Patel: fixed the link and pushed.
Jonah Reed: CI for docs rendering failed on the table alignment in Markdown — the table needs a blank line above it. small tweak.
Mira Patel: fixed formatting and updated the PR.
Alex Wu: FYI, I manually tested the SDK snippet in a local env. Streaming example now uses `client.generate_stream(..., max_length=1024)` — looks good.
Samira (docs-bot): spellcheck passed. Rendering check passed. No further automated failures.
Jonah Reed: can we get an approving review from docs or runtime before merge? tagging @docs-team and @runtime-owners in the PR.
Mira Patel: pinged reviewers. If no objections, plan to merge tomorrow morning after the rebenchmark ticket is created.
Kai: created ticket INF-1892 to re-run full benchmarks on runtime v1.14. Adding cross-link in PR.
Mira Patel: perfect — added the ticket link to the PR description and added a short "TODO: rebenchmark" callout in the card.
Alex Wu: LGTM from me after the SDK snippet change.
Jonah Reed: +1 from me too.
Mira Patel: thanks all — I'll wait for docs-team approval then merge. :white_check_mark:
Samira (docs-bot): Merge window check: safe to merge during non-deploy hours (02:00-09:00 UTC). No conflicts detected.
Mira Patel: merging after docs-team approval (will wait until 08:00 UTC).
Samira (docs-bot): PR merged by Mira Patel at 4512004012. Changelog updated: "tilde-8b: compat notes, limits table, SDK snippet fix"
Kai: thanks — closing loop.
